titleEs: Last Epoch Info (TunkLab) vs Last Epoch Fandom — DB-style vs wiki-style
titleEn: Last Epoch Info (TunkLab) vs Last Epoch Fandom — DB-style vs wiki-style
descriptionEs: TunkLab es database técnica con calculators; Fandom es wiki narrativa con coverage amplio. Cubren reference needs distintos pero complementarios.
descriptionEn: TunkLab is a technical database with calculators; Fandom is a narrative wiki with broad coverage. They cover different but complementary reference needs.
verdictEs: TunkLab para data crudo, calculators y theorycrafting. Fandom para lore, mechanics explained y quest walkthroughs. No compiten; sirven a needs distintos.
verdictEn: TunkLab for raw data, calculators, and theorycrafting. Fandom for lore, explained mechanics, and quest walkthroughs. They don't compete; they serve different needs.

useCases.labelEs: Lookup técnico de affixes y stat ranges
useCases.labelEn: Technical lookup of affixes and stat ranges
useCases.reasonEs: TunkLab tiene database catalogada por type con stat ranges precisos. Fandom tiene info pero en formato narrativo, menos browseable.
useCases.reasonEn: TunkLab has type-cataloged database with precise stat ranges. Fandom has info but in narrative format, less browseable.

useCases.reasonEs: TunkLab tiene calculators dedicados que ningún otro hub provee. Fandom no tiene tools interactivos.
useCases.reasonEn: TunkLab has dedicated calculators no other hub provides. Fandom has no interactive tools.

useCases.reasonEs: Fandom tiene quest walkthroughs detallados y lore artículos extensos. TunkLab es technical reference, no narrativa.
useCases.reasonEn: Fandom has detailed quest walkthroughs and extensive lore articles. TunkLab is technical reference, not narrative.

useCases.reasonEs: Fandom tiene patch history compilado. TunkLab actualiza data del current patch sin maintainear archive de versions pasadas.
useCases.reasonEn: Fandom has compiled patch history. TunkLab updates current patch data without maintaining a past-versions archive.

useCases.reasonEs: TunkLab UI es spartan pero funcional sin ads. Fandom es UI corporate cargada con ads pesados.
useCases.reasonEn: TunkLab UI is spartan but functional without ads. Fandom has corporate cluttered UI with heavy ads.
